referees.quote: I believe that substantial additional work—particularly restructuring and improved analysis/explanation—would be required before the manuscript could be considered for publication.
The manuscript is well-written, and easy to follow... However, I have a few minor comments and requests for clarification
I co-reviewed this manuscript with one of the reviewers who provided the listed reports.
several points require clarification or minor improvement before publication... With clarification of the points above... would be suitable for publication in Nature Communications.

note: First round is Version 0. The file shows no transfer from another journal. R3 only co-reviewed with an unnamed referee among R1, R2 and R4, so their recommendation cannot be determined. 'Minor revision' is a placeholder matching two of the three possible partners (R2, R4). It would be 'major revision' if R3 co-reviewed with R1. None of the referees used the scale terms directly, so all levels are inferred.
